name: The Spirits of Stonetalon
label: Quest
description: Unrest stirs among the spirits of Stonetalon, and Zor Lonetree sends Horde champions west to learn why. From Orgrimmar, they travel past the Crossroads…

clips.title: The story
paras: Unrest stirs among the spirits of Stonetalon, and Zor Lonetree sends Horde champions west to learn why. From Orgrimmar, they travel past the Crossroads and report directly to Seereth Stonebreak near Greatwood Vale.

In Grommash Hold, Zor Lonetree listens to the natural world and feels deep distress from the Stonetalon Mountains. The elemental spirits of its rocky peaks are furious as logging tears into their forests. Horde shamans hear that unrest and fear the devastation in the western highlands will upset Kalimdor's spiritual balance.

The Venture Company, an unscrupulous goblin syndicate, is cutting timber in Greatwood Vale. Its commercial crews use aggressive machinery, saws, and muscle to butcher the ancient woodland instead of harvesting sustainably. The Horde sent Seereth Stonebreak, a young shaman, to watch the forest from the frontier and rally defenders against the ravagers.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: The spirits of the Stonetalon Mountains are angered, for goblins and their servants are plundering and burning the land. So the land has cried out, and those who listen for such things... Have heard.
Seereth Stonebreak, a promising shaman of the Horde, was sent to Stonetalon. She reports massive deforestation at the hands of the goblins, and requests aid.
Meet Seereth in Stonetalon. To reach her, follow the road west of the Barrens' Crossroads. She is camped near the Greatwood Vale.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Ah, an adventurer. Very good. We will need your skills to deal with these plunderers!
